name: Portugal Tech Week 2026

why.text: The festival ran 6 to 15 November 2026, so its events list holds nothing on now or in the next 60 days; no terms page found. robots.txt (read 18 Nov 2026) disallows only time-zone folders, wc-logs, add-to-cart and wp-admin, not /events/; the page has an RSS feed link (/events/?feed=rss2), which answered with the HTML page, not a feed.
why.basis: nothing in the window; no terms page found

notes: Check again for the 2027 edition. Event pages on it are evidence only; many events are hosted on Luma and similar platforms, which are not read.
